blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 12:24 PM October 13, 2026

MANILA, Philippines – On Day 39 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, the court will tackle administrative matters, particularly the handling of confidential documents in the prosecution’s formal offer of evidence.

items: The court will finalize the order covering the confidential documents presented by the prosecution before the court goes to a break.
The House prosecution panel is also expected to manifest on the floor its decision to drop Article III of the impeachment case or Duterte’s alleged bribery of Department of Education officials.
The trial will then be go for a break until November 9.
